Classify a pedon under the Hungarian diagnostic soil classification

Source: R/key-hscs2024.R
classify_hscs2024.Rd

Keys a PedonRecord through the Hungarian diagnostic soil classification of Micheli et al. (2024, second approximation), following its key to the soil types. Experimental: this release keys the 15 types (Laptalaj, Antropogen talaj, Koves-sziklas vaztalaj, Kozethatasu talaj, Szolonyec talaj, Szoloncsak talaj, Duzzado agyagtalaj, Reti talaj, Karbonat talaj, Mezosegi talaj, Agyagbemosodasos talaj, Homoktalaj, Barnafold, Hordalektalaj, Foldeskopar). Since v0.9.316 the name also carries the subtype properties of the type's table (before the type, the first with a capital letter) and its variety properties (after it, in parentheses), in the table's order, with the depth modifiers of 8.7 (felszintol, sekelyen, kozepmelyen, melyben) on properties defined by a layer: e.g. "Savanyu, humuszszegeny Agyagbemosodasos talaj (sekelyen kozettormelekes)", with the accents.

Usage

classify_hscs2024(
  pedon,
  rules = NULL,
  on_missing = c("warn", "silent", "error"),
  gapfill = FALSE
)

Arguments

pedon

A PedonRecord.

rules

Optional pre-loaded rule set (load_rules("hscs2024")).

on_missing

One of "warn" (default), "silent", "error".

gapfill

Opt-in within-pedon gap-fill, as in classify_usda.

Value

A ClassificationResult with system_id "hscs2024", the full name in name and the type in rsg_or_order; levels has the type with its English gloss and one row per subtype and variety property named; qualifiers holds the subtypes, the varieties and status, every property of the type's table with its verdict (TRUE, FALSE, NA), depth and label; and the key trace and provisional_because (types before the assigned one that could not be decided).

Details

The names are the Hungarian singular, as the text's naming example writes them; levels$name_en gives an English gloss. The key reads the FAO (2006) horizon notation the text adopts (an l or r suffix shows reductive conditions; i slickensides; k carbonates; n sodium; p ploughing; t clay accumulation; u artefacts; w a cambic horizon), moist and dry Munsell colours, texture (Hungarian names of the USDA triangle the text prints, English names, or lab clay, silt and sand), organic carbon, bulk density, CaCO3, effervescence, secondary carbonates, base saturation, exchangeable Na, Mg and the CEC, structure, slickensides, cracks, clay films, coarse fragments, artefacts, the layer origin, the dipyridyl test (childs_test), redoximorphic features, and the total water-soluble salts (soluble_salts_pct, Hungarian method). From the site it reads land_use, methane_odour, geomembrane, mechanical_mixing_depth_cm and anthropic_truncation. Features a describer records when met (artefacts, mottles, secondary carbonates, cracks) are absent when not recorded. The choices where the text is silent are listed in system.file("rules", "hscs2024", "readings.yaml", package = "soilKey").

References

Micheli E., Fuchs M., Lang V., Csorba A., Dobos E., Szegi T., Kele G. (2024). A diagnosztikus szemleletu hazai talajosztalyozasi rendszer. Utmutato. Masodik kozelites. Magyar Agrar- es Elettudomanyi Egyetem, Godollo.

See also

make_hscs2024_example, soilkey_systems.

Examples

res <- classify_hscs2024(make_hscs2024_example("steppe"), on_missing = "silent")
res$name
#> [1] "Középmélyen erősen karbonátos, mély humuszos rétegű, igen erősen humuszos, fekete Mezőségi talaj (iszapos vályog)"
res$levels
#>                        level                 code                          name
#> 1                      types                  MEZ                Mezőségi talaj
#> eros_karbonatos      subtype      eros_karbonatos középmélyen erősen karbonátos
#> mely_humuszos_retegu subtype mely_humuszos_retegu          mély humuszos rétegű
#> igen_erosen_humuszos subtype igen_erosen_humuszos          igen erősen humuszos
#> fekete               subtype               fekete                        fekete
#> textura              variety              textura                iszapos vályog
#>                                           name_en
#> 1                    Steppe soil (chernozem-like)
#> eros_karbonatos               strongly calcareous
#> mely_humuszos_retegu      with a deep humic layer
#> igen_erosen_humuszos          very strongly humic
#> fekete                                      black
#> textura                             texture class
